prompt: Which is the UPPERCASE (capital) version of the letter "a"?
hint: Uppercase letters are BIG letters — the capital version of 'a' is...
correct_feedback: Yes! Big A is the uppercase, or capital, version of little a. Great job!
incorrect_feedback: Good try! Little a and its big letter make the same sound. Which BIG letter goes with little a?
reveal_feedback: That one was tricky! The uppercase version of a is A. Now you know!
